description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigService class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages configuration settings for the system, including retrieval and update of various configuration keys, integration with LDAP, password policies, localization, and OAuth token TTLs. The class interacts with a ConfigDao data access object to persist and fetch configuration values, and provides methods to access specific configuration parameters used throughout the HRM system.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: A service class that manages system configuration parameters, providing methods for retrieving and updating configuration values, handling specific system settings such as localization, LDAP, OAuth TTLs, and feature flags.
